description: Developer tools whose majors merge by themselves (web and react-native presets extend this after default)

packageRules.description: Majors of developer tools (linters, formatters, test runners, TypeScript) merge by themselves: none of them is in what ships (Vite, Next and Metro build without them), and verify runs each of them (lint, typecheck, test). The strict- branch prefix makes verify judge the PR as if the contract deadline were today, so a tool that fails or cannot run turns the check red instead of 'tolerated' (ESLint 10 without eslint.config.* did). No @types/* beyond Jest's: type packages of libraries move with their library's group. At most 2 open bot PRs when one is created, so these never take the routine updates' slots
